scope: Audit-selected sample, not all Odisha projects. Later visits and January2026 responses retain their own dates.
missing_value_rule: Source dashes are null, not asserted zeros.

projects.title: Keonjhar DHH neonatal and paediatric intensive-care units
projects.completion_evidence: Equipment installed March2022, as information furnished to audit; not a recovered completion certificate.
projects.audit_finding: Joint physical verification found the units unused and staff/doctors not deployed.
projects.government_reply: Government said the assets strengthened healthcare infrastructure during a crisis.
projects.audit_rejoinder: CAG said the response did not address continued non-use.
projects.government_reply_provenance: Response reproduced in CAG report, not separately retrieved government letter

projects.title: Digital medical records in three Sundargarh district hospitals
projects.completion_evidence: Installed at SDH Bonai September2019; DHH Sundargarh and Government Hospital Rourkela November2019.
projects.service_status_at_observation: DHH_system_nonfunctional; other hospital cessation dates from audit records
projects.audit_finding: Reported operation ended25February2020 at DHH/GH and28December2020 at Bonai. Audit visit found DHH system nonfunctional and24 of40 tablets idle; compatibility with state hospital software was cited.
projects.government_reply: Government acknowledged nonfunctionality and said vendor engagement had not resolved compatibility.
projects.audit_rejoinder: CAG treated the system expenditure as infructuous; no recovery or restoration established.
projects.government_reply_provenance: Response reproduced in CAG report, not separately retrieved government letter

projects.title: Boys and girls hostels at Deogan, Sukinda
projects.expenditure_period: Construction completed16July2022; cumulative cost stated in audit
projects.completion_evidence: CAG cites completion certificate dated16July2022; underlying certificate not independently retrieved.
projects.audit_finding: Water/electricity arrangements pending; hostels not handed over to Education Department.
projects.government_reply: Government said handover to BDO Sukinda would follow provision of critical utilities.
projects.audit_rejoinder: CAG retained the prolonged non-use finding.
projects.government_reply_provenance: Response reproduced in CAG report, not separately retrieved government letter

projects.title: Birsa Munda Hockey Stadium: DMF-funded share
projects.expenditure_period: DMF releases January–September2022; expenditure reported in audit
projects.completion_evidence: Audit reports constructed stadium and functioning at joint physical verification.
projects.audit_finding: CAG questioned eligibility of DMF financing for an international stadium and benefit to mining-affected people. Functionality is distinct from funding eligibility.
projects.government_reply: Government described it as a critical project in the larger public interest and cited Sports Department permission.
projects.audit_rejoinder: CAG maintained that this permission did not authorise the DMF use.
projects.government_reply_provenance: Response reproduced in CAG report, not separately retrieved government letter
